damR
text: DiffMetabolites() uses limma compute differential abundance metabolites specified groups. unspecified, unique Group identifiers compared. default, produce contrasts directions make comparisons easy view plot: groups , B, C contrasts - B, - C, B - C well B - , C - , C - B. Set reverseContrasts = FALSE want just one direction.  PCA plots, setting interactive = TRUE produces interactive volcano plots. PlotAllVolcanoes() can plot multiple groups, returned lit plots. collect captions show fold-changes capped common main title single title caption.
code: groups <- unique(imputed_data$Group)  results <- DiffMetabolites(imputed_data)  PlotVolcano(results, groups[c(1, 5)], contrastTitle = "Example", cap = 5) all_volcanoes.list <- PlotAllVolcanoes(   results,   groups[c(1:3)],   cap = 10,   contrastTitle = "Example",   interactive = ggiraph_available )  # extract the caption to 'collect' it caption <- all_volcanoes.list[[1]]@labels$caption title <- all_volcanoes.list[[1]]@labels$title  # drop the titles and captions all_volcanoes <- lapply(all_volcanoes.list, \(p) p + labs(title = NULL, caption = NULL)) |>   wrap_plots(guides = "collect") &   theme_minimal(7) &   theme(legend.position = "top") &   plot_annotation(title = title, caption = caption)  if (ggiraph_available) ggiraph::girafe(all_volcanoes) else all_volcanoes
